archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-wire
archetypes.rationale: The dormant wrapper and child share an identity-bound merge-result contract across Bash and Python.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed CI fixer lane and dormant Step 8 wrapper as one wire protocol. Focus on deterministic identity, stale-result rejection, symlink containment, re-entry behavior, and agreement between the durable status file and bgjob merge-result envelope. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
